results = []
for req in to_approve:
    result = apis.venmo.approve_payment_request(payment_request_id=req["payment_request_id"], access_token=venmo_token)
    results.append((req["payment_request_id"], req["sender"]["email"], result))
    print(req["payment_request_id"], req["sender"]["name"], result)

remaining = []
page_index = 0
while True:
    page = apis.venmo.show_received_payment_requests(access_token=venmo_token, status='pending', page_index=page_index, page_limit=20)
    if not page:
        break
    remaining.extend(page)
    if len(page) < 20:
        break
    page_index += 1

still_from_targets = [r for r in remaining if r["sender"]["email"].lower() in target_emails]
